File Description: 
*List of HCPCS Codes payable under the OPPS that are designated as device-intensive procedures.
*The CY 2027 portion of the APC payment amounts uniquely associated with the cost of devices. The device offset percentage for each HCPCS code is used to evaluate whether the procedure is designated as device-intensive, which is required to have a device offset greater than 30 percent, and meet other criteria.

*The applicable device offset amount is the product of the APC payment rate multiplied by the HCPCS code device offset percentage.

*Device cost statistics reflect the data from CY 2025 used for ratesetting for this CY 2027 OPPS/ASC final rule with comment period.
